title: Dense Donut labels need bounded collision handling

complexity.rationale: The final behavior requires slice-derived placement, rendered-edge geometry, per-row collision bounds, and deterministic runtime filtering for both Direct and Advanced labels.

summary: S2 Donut labels stay on Vega's natural slice bisector with the nearest point of each rendered block exactly 20px beyond the ring. Fixed-position overlaps are resolved by retaining larger segments first and hiding lower-priority labels without moving them.
symptom: Dense Direct and Advanced label blocks overlap when every eligible label is rendered at its fixed slice-derived position. Advanced swatches can also appear offset from the slice when they inherit the name row's vertical offset.
rootCause: Fixed bisector placement needs a separate visibility pass because moving labels breaks slice alignment and the exact ring gap. A single maximum-width rectangle overstates multi-row labels by treating empty space beside shorter rows as occupied, so collision checks must compare the actual rendered rectangle of each row.

comparison.expected: Every visible label is centered on the segment's angular bisector with its nearest rendered edge exactly 20px beyond the donut, and lower-priority overlapping labels are hidden without moving surviving labels.
comparison.actual: Rendering every eligible label creates overlaps, while position-adjustment approaches move labels away from their slice midpoint or the fixed ring distance.

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Direct and Advanced labels remain fixed at their slice anchors, with smaller overlapping labels hidden.

edgeCases.case: One dominant segment with many slivers
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The dominant label remains visible and overlapping sliver labels are hidden without moving any anchor.

edgeCases.case: Total requested label height exceeds one hemisphere
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Hide lower-priority overlapping labels until every visible fixed-position block has sufficient separation.

edgeCases.case: Sparse datasets with one or two labels per hemisphere
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The existing no-collision positioning remains unchanged.

crossCutting.notes: The visibility filter only removes fixed-position candidates whose rendered rows violate the 4px minimum gap. S1 has no equivalent Advanced label geometry, so parity is not required.

implementationPlan.change: Define the shared 4px minimum gap used by Donut label collision filtering.
Generate fixed polar coordinates from the pie arc's angular midpoint, using each block's actual inward extent to keep its nearest rendered edge exactly 20px from the donut.
Verify normalized hemisphere selection and the exact rendered-edge distance across representative slice angles.

Build candidate and visible data sources for Direct and Advanced labels, derive a collision rectangle for each rendered row, filter fixed-position overlaps with a 4px minimum gap, and anchor the Advanced swatch and name row directly to the slice-derived label Y coordinate.
implementationPlan.lines: Direct and rich SegmentLabel data and swatch mark

implementationPlan.change: Expose a deterministic visibility expression that evaluates larger segments first within each hemisphere and rejects candidates only when a rendered row comes within 4px of an accepted label row on both axes.
Verify candidate and visible data sources, fixed row layout, per-row collision boxes, visibility filtering, and the Advanced swatch and name row's direct slice-anchor Y encoding.
implementationPlan.lines: Direct and rich SegmentLabel data and position tests

implementationPlan.change: Verify priority ordering, hemisphere isolation, row-level overlap detection, and the 4px minimum gap.
Run dense datasets through Vega and verify every visible block's nearest rendered edge remains exactly 20px from the donut with no row pairs violating the 4px gap.
